Codes and messages are the docs' own: MAGNET_MUST_BE_PREMIUM and MAGNET_TOO_MANY_ACTIVE from the magnet/upload endpoint errors, FREE_TRIAL_LIMIT_REACHED from the global error list. No AllDebrid trial account was available to capture which shape a trial gets (Fizzy #363), so every code is recorded in both shapes. Replace with a real trial capture when one exists.
